description: This file defines a factory class for creating and configuring Jackson ObjectMapper instances specifically for the Fineract client. It includes custom configuration settings, registration of modules such as JavaTimeModule and a custom ExternalIdAdapter, and provides a singleton shared instance.

classes.name: ObjectMapperFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing methods to create and access a pre-configured Jackson ObjectMapper used within the Fineract client.

methods.name: createObjectMapper
methods.description: Creates and configures a new ObjectMapper instance with specific settings, modules, and properties.

methods.name: getShared
methods.description: Returns a singleton, shared ObjectMapper instance configured by createObjectMapper.
